clips.title: The story
paras: Valgan's Field is an abandoned wheat farm nestled in northern Silverpine Forest, overlooking Lordamere Lake. Once a picturesque homestead, it now lies desolate and overrun by the feral Moonrage worgen unleashed by Archmage Arugal.

Situated just west of the Shining Strand and north of the nearby river, Valgan's Field was once a prosperous wheat farm offering scenic views of Lordamere Lake. That peaceful life vanished when the Scourge tore through Lordaeron, forcing its owner, Valgan, to flee or meet his end. Left untended, the ruined structures fell into the claws of feral Moonrage worgen prowling down from Shadowfang Keep. Before the Third War, the mage Arugal spent time here, leaving behind remnants of his arcane research that now draw the attention of the Forsaken.
